cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: The Iron Pillar in Delhi is notable for its ancient ironworking and unusual resistance to corrosion.

cards.label: ROOTS & INDIA
cards.title: How was the Interim Government intended to operate?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: It was intended to function as a cabinet government, rather than merely as separate departmental heads operating under the Viceroy.

cards.label: ROOTS & INDIA
cards.title: India’s literary past is best described as…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: India’s literary traditions include works in Sanskrit, Tamil, Pali, Prakrit and many other languages across long periods.

cards.label: ROOTS & INDIA
cards.title: What does “ज्ञानम्” mean?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: ज्ञानम् (jñānam) means “knowledge.” The source connects it with the idea of illuminating life.

cards.label: ROOTS & INDIA
cards.title: Aryabhata is especially associated with…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Aryabhata wrote the Aryabhatiya in 499 CE, covering mathematics and astronomy.

cards.label: ROOTS & INDIA
cards.title: When someone calls an ancient teaching 'timeless', what should that mean?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Its principle still survives careful testing

cards.explain: A principle earns modern relevance when it remains useful under current evidence and ethics—not simply because it is old.
